verdict.rationale: FFmpeg's docs say streamcopy can be used for 'modifying container-level metadata' without re-encoding, and cropping metadata is now carried in Matroska and MP4. That shows its own metadata handling, but the evidence never documents preservation by default or a strip-on-request option. A hands-on report also describes ffmpeg losing color/ICC information from Apple .mov QuickTime headers during conversion, which undercuts preservation fidelity. missing for 10: documented metadata preservation behavior across conversions, an explicit option to strip metadata, evidence that color/ICC and other rich metadata survive conversion, independent corroboration of metadata handling.
